TABATABAI:103:2-3/r4.anchor: وظاهر قوله { وعملوا الصالحات } التلبس بجميع الأعمال الصالحة فلا يشمل الاستثناء الفساق بترك بعض الصالحات

TABATABAI:103:2-3/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r5.claim: For sinful believers, loss in some dimensions ends when punishment ceases through intercession or similar means; the obstinate unbeliever remains punished eternally.
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r5.anchor: كالمؤمن الفاسق الذي لا يخلد في النار وينقطع عنه العذاب بشفاعة ونحوها

TABATABAI:103:2-3/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r6.claim: Tawasi bi'l-haqq means urging one another to follow and remain with truth; it exceeds commanding right and forbidding wrong because it includes belief and all encouragement toward good deeds.
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r6.anchor: أي باتباعه والدوام عليه فليس دين الحق إلا اتباع الحق اعتقادا وعملا

TABATABAI:103:2-3/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r7.claim: Mutual counsel toward truth is itself a righteous deed and is singled out after the general mention of good works to emphasize its importance.
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r7.anchor: ثم التواصي بالحق من العمل الصالح فذكره بعد العمل الصالح من قبيل ذكر الخاص بعد العام

TABATABAI:103:2-3/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r8.claim: Counsel toward patience is included in counsel toward truth but is named separately for emphasis; repeating the verb supports this distinction.
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r8.anchor: كما أن التواصي بالصبر من التواصي بالحق وذكره بعده من ذكر الخاص بعد العام

TABATABAI:103:2-3/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r9.claim: Their mutual counsel after faith and good works signals living hearts and openness to submission, with special care for truth's authority to spread and persist among people.
TABATABAI:103:2-3/r9.anchor: للاشارة إلى حياة قلوبهم وإنشراح صدورهم للإسلام لله فلهم اهتمام خاص

THALABI:v10p283#3/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p283#3/r7.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p283#3/r7.claim: Tawāsaw means urging and advising one another.

THALABI:v10p283#3/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p283#3/r8.speaker: الحسن وقتادة
THALABI:v10p283#3/r8.claim: They identify the truth that believers urge one another to uphold as the Quran.

THALABI:v10p283#3/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p283#3/r9.speaker: مقاتل
THALABI:v10p283#3/r9.claim: He says the truth means faith and affirmation of God’s oneness.

THALABI:v10p283#3/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p283#3/r10.speaker: قيل
THALABI:v10p283#3/r10.claim: Another interpretation is mutual exhortation to act according to the truth.

THALABI:v10p283#3/r11.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p283#3/r11.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p283#3/r11.claim: Patience means steadfastness in carrying out religious duties and upholding God’s command.
THALABI:v10p283#3/r11.anchor: على أداء الفرائض وإقامة أمر الله

THALABI:v10p283#3/r17.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p283#3/r17.speaker: أبي بن كعب
THALABI:v10p283#3/r17.claim: Ubayy says he recited the surah to the Prophet and asked him for its interpretation.
THALABI:v10p283#3/r17.anchor: عن أبي أمامة عن أبي بن كعب قال: قرأت على رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) والعصر فقلت:

THALABI:v10p284/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p284/r1.speaker: النبي
THALABI:v10p284/r1.claim: The Prophet says al-asr is an oath by God on behalf of the audience at the day’s end; he identifies the person in loss with Abu Jahl and the believers, righteous deeds, truth, and patience in turn with Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali.
THALABI:v10p284/r1.anchor: فقال: «والعصر قسم من الله أقسم لكم بآخر النهار» إن الإنسان لفي خسر قال: «أبو جهل بن هشام»

THALABI:v10p284/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p284/r2.speaker: علي بن عبد الله بن عباس
THALABI:v10p284/r2.claim: While preaching from the Prophet’s pulpit, he recited the surah and repeated the same identifications of Abu Jahl, Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali with its phrases.
THALABI:v10p284/r2.anchor: فوافيت علي بن عبد الله بن عباس يخطب على منبر رسول الله

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:103:1-3/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:103:1-3/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:103:1-3/r3.claim: Believers escape loss through faith, good works, mutual counsel to remain firm in monotheism and faith, and patience in obedience and striving in God's path.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:103:1-3/r3.anchor: { وتواصوا بالحق } وصى بعضهم بالإقامة على التوحيد والإيمان { وتواصوا بالصبر }

ELMALILI:103:1-3/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3/r1.claim: The rendering says: By the age; humankind is in absolute loss, except those who believe, do righteous works, counsel one another to truth, and counsel patience.
ELMALILI:103:1-3/r1.anchor: Kasem olsun ki asra (1) insan mutlak bir hüsranda (2)

ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r2.claim: Human life is precious capital; each unprofitable instant wastes it, but a final righteous act may make up for years of waste and win eternal paradise.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r2.anchor: İnsanın ömrü en kıymetli sermayesidir. Ne kazanacaksa onunla kazanacaktır

ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r3.claim: Sufis say a person should be the child of the moment: value the present and use it to gain good for the afterlife.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r3.anchor: sûfiyye, “sûfî ibnü’l-vakt olmalıdır; yani ömrünün ve bilhassa fiilen içinde bulunduğu vakt-i hâlin

ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r6.claim: Time's senses of restraint and bestowal can support both the loss side and the exception of those who gain through faith and good works.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r6.anchor: asrın dehr ü zaman mânası mülâhaza olunurken men‘ve atâ mânalarına da işaret edilmiş bulunduğu hafî değildir

ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r10.claim: The oath warns that time consumes life and leaves people in loss unless they believe and do good works.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#2/r10.anchor: o geçen leyl ü nehar vücûdunu kemirmekte ve bu suretle o her dem hüsran içinde kalmaktadır

ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r1.claim: The first Prophetic-era phase began with Muhammad's mission amid religious disorder, extinguished guidance, and widespread ignorance, disbelief, injustice, and corruption.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r1.anchor: nübüvvet, fazilet, hakk u adalet, ma‘rifetullah

ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r2.claim: The Qur'an began descending with the command iqra on a Night of Power, and prophetic light rose to call humanity toward reform, paradise, and divine approval.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r2.anchor: bir leyle-i kadirde اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ emriyle Kur’an nâzil olarak nûr-ı nübüvvet tulû‘etmişti

ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r3.claim: As discussed in Surat al-Bayyina, spreading the upright religion called people away from total loss and began transformations that led from the middle ages to the last era.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#3/r3.anchor: لَمْ يَكُن Sûresi’nde geçtiği üzere dîn-i kayyimenin neşriyle insanlığı şerrü’l-beriyyenin istîlâsından

ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r13.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r13.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r13.claim: Life is a limited loan belonging to the Creator, entrusted to people to invest well; their benefit depends on the profit made by spending it.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r13.anchor: insanın kendi milki değil, yaratan Hâlık teâlâ’nın milki olup O’nun nâmına güzel tasarruf ederek

ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r14.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r14.claim: A person receives only what they strive for and is held accountable for what they earn.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r14.anchor: İnsanın bütün istifadesi onun sarf u mübâdelesinden hâsıl olacak kâra bağlıdır

ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r15.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r15.claim: After returning the loaned capital to its owner, people are saved and rewarded according to their profit or left liable, bankrupt, and punished according to their deficit; the scales express this reckoning.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r15.anchor: hesap günü kendisine kalacak olan kâra göre kendisini kurtaracak ve o nisbette mütena‘‘im olacak

ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r16.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r16.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r16.claim: Every breath spent idly is loss; a worldly or neutral act leaves no lasting gain, evil is certainly loss, and even obedience could have been done better.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r16.anchor: Bir mubah ise bir eseri kalmamak itibariyle boşuna geçmiş gibidir. Bir şer ise muhakkak bir hüsrandır

ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r17.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r17.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r17.claim: Because knowledge of Allah and His majesty can grow without limit, greater knowledge should produce deeper awe and love and more complete worship; settling for less entails some loss.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r17.anchor: insanın Allah’a ilmi ne kadar çok olursa haşyet ve mahabbeti de o nisbette çok

ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r21.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r21.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r21.claim: Those with the four traits named in the next verse are exceptions to loss and instead gain.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#4/r21.anchor: Ancak o kimseler müstesnâ şu zikrolunacak dört vasıf ile muttasıf olanlar hüsranda değil, kârdadırlar

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r1.claim: Believers affirm God's oneness and revelation, worship sincerely, and believe in the afterlife's moral distinctions and recompense.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r1.anchor: Allah’ın birliğini ve indirdiğini tasdik edip O’na ihlâs ile ibadet ve tâate ikrar vermişler

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r2.claim: Faith must permeate the believer's faculties and will, producing deeds aligned with belief, God's commands, truth, and good for self and others.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r2.anchor: imanları yalnız gönüllerinde ve dillerinde kalmamış, bütün hislerine, akıllarına, mevcudiyetlerine nüfuz ederek iradelerine sâhip olmuşlar

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r3.claim: Righteous action includes fulfilling duties and avoiding major sins and indecencies; scripture and Sunna detail its foundations, with particulars entrusted to consensus and juristic reasoning.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r3.anchor: emrolunan vazifeleri edâ, nehyolunan kebâir ve fevâhişten ictinab eylemişlerdir ki bunların esası Kitap ve Sünnet’te tafsil olunmuştur

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r4.claim: After faith, righteous action has two kinds: bodily acts that benefit the agent and acts such as alms that benefit others, perfecting self or other.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r4.anchor: Birisi bedenî ibadetler gibi mükellefin evvelen

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r5.claim: The most important outward good deeds are inviting others to truth and striving in its path.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r5.anchor: Bunun en mühimi de hakka davet ve hak yolunda mücahededir

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r6.claim: Those who counsel one another in truth direct their resolve, faith, deeds, and speech toward truth, since what is not directed to truth is falsehood and loss.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r6.anchor: bütün azimleri hakka müteveccih, imanları da amelleri de kavilleri de hep hakka masruf olmuş; çünkü hakka masruf olmayan her şey bâtıldır, hasardır

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r7.claim: Mutual counsel in truth means doing and uniting upon what is established and right, calling to truth, commanding good, forbidding wrong, and acting uprightly.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r7.anchor: her işte hak, sâbit, doğru olanı yapmayı, hak üzere birleşmeyi, hep hakka davet eylemeyi, emr bi’l-ma‘rûf ve nehy ani’l-münkeri

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r8.claim: Counseling patience is necessary because worldly distractions, desires, and the many who lose make good works and truthful speech painful and demanding.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r8.anchor: hayır yapmak, hak söylemek, hak yolunda gitmek birçok acılar çekmeye, zorluklara katlanmaya, mücahede etmeye

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r9.claim: Luqman 31:17 explicitly advises those who command right and forbid wrong to bear patiently what befalls them, calling this resolve among great matters.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r9.anchor: diye isabet edecek musibetlere sabır tavsiye edilerek onun azme mütevakkıf

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r10.claim: As in al-Balad, the fortunate are believers who surmount the steep path and counsel both compassion and patience to one another.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r10.anchor: “akabe”yi iktiham eden ve iman edip de birbirlerine hem merhamet hem sabır tavsiye edenlerin meymenet sâhipleri oldukları

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r11.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r11.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r11.claim: Patience keeps people from retreating or weakening in difficult trials, and includes mutual support through worship, affliction, and resistance to desire.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r11.anchor: caymamayı, yılmamayı, bıkmamayı, zaaf göstermemeyi ve böylelikle birbirlerini yardımsız, tesellîsiz bırakmayıp gerek tâat ve amel ve gerek âlâm ve mesâib ve gerek şehevâta karşı sabr u metanet tavsiye etmeyi

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r12.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r12.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r12.claim: Patience is the soul's strength to endure pain and hardship in doing good or avoiding evil; the source distinguishes two principal kinds.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r12.anchor: Mâlum ki sabır nefsin iyi bir iş yapmak veya fenalıklardan

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r13.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r13.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r13.claim: One kind of patience bears the hardship of obedience, striving, and good works, enabling the achievements of people with high aspiration.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r13.anchor: Birisi elem ve külfete sabırdır ki bununla tâat ve mücahedenin ve güzel amellerin

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r14.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r14.claim: Another kind resists pleasure and desire, protecting people from forbidden acts and attractive but dangerous harms.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r14.anchor: Birisi de lezzet ve şehevâta karşı sabırdır ki bununla da haramdan, menhiyyâttan

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r15.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r15.claim: Innate capacity matters, but training, habit, resolve, will, and especially faith also shape patience.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r15.anchor: fıtrî kābiliyetin bir hükmü bulunduğu münker olmamakla beraber terbiyenin

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r16.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r16.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r16.claim: Patience is commanded as a voluntary duty; believers are told to persevere, outdo others in patience, stand guard, and fear God to prosper.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r16.anchor: sabır, ef‘âl-i ihtiyâriyeden olarak ef‘âl-i mükellefîn meyânında tavsiye olunduğu

ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r17.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r17.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r17.claim: The author cites God's support and limitless reward for the patient, including praise for those who respond to calamity by affirming their return to God.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#5/r17.anchor: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r1.claim: Hadiths describe patience as the key to relief and say that the patient triumphs.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r1.anchor: مَنْ صَبـَرَ ظَفَرَ “sabreden zafer bulur”[^47] diye vârid olduğu gibi

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r2.claim: Turkish proverbs likewise call patience the beginning of knowledge and say its end is well-being.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r2.anchor: dilimizde de “ilmin başı sabırdır”, “sabrın sonu selâmettir”

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r3.claim: The praised patience is faith-filled perseverance in good work and truth, marked by courage, fidelity, and honor, rather than passive acquiescence to evil or humiliation.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r3.anchor: memduh olan ve tavsiye edilen sabır, iman ve amel-i sâlih ile hak ve hayır yolunda sabırdır ki bu şecaat, sadakat, mertlik şi‘ârıdır

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r4.claim: Accepting evil is itself evil and accepting unbelief is unbelief; patience cannot mean inertia, remaining trapped in wrong, or failing to try to escape degradation.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r4.anchor: şerre rızâ şer, küfre rızâ küfürdür

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r5.claim: The Prophet approved a poet's saying that gentleness without forceful outbursts to protect its purity has no good in it; the poet is not named here.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r5.anchor: Resûlullah beğenmişti: وَلاَ خَيْرَ فِي حِلْمٍ إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ بَوادِرُ تَحْمِي صَفْوَهُ

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r6.claim: A sound hadith commands changing a wrong by hand, then by speech if unable, then by the heart if unable, which is the weakest faith.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r6.anchor: “sizden her kim bir münker, bir biçimsizlik görürse onu eliyle değiştirsin. Ona gücü yetmeyen diliyle

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r7.claim: Qur'an 6:68 and 4:140 instruct believers to leave gatherings where God's signs are mocked, supporting active resistance rather than passive patience.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r7.anchor: فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r8.claim: Even when patience is inappropriate, believers should act with insight rather than panic or rashness, following the prophetic way of calling to God knowingly.

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r9.claim: Only those with faith, righteous works, mutual counsel in truth, and mutual counsel in patience are exceptions to humanity's otherwise absolute loss; all four express complete faith.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r9.anchor: ancak böyle iman, sâlih ameller, tevâsî bi’l-hak, tevâsî bi’s-sabr dört vasıf ile muttasıf olan kimseler hüsranda değil, müstesnâdırlar

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r10.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r10.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r10.claim: True faith in the real and abiding God cannot fail; a life spent in beautiful works for God is never wasted, while faith in falsehood and its deeds vanish.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r10.anchor: O’nun yolunda güzel amellere sarfedilmiş bulunan bir hayat, bir ömür hiçbir zaman boşa gitmez

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r11.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r11.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r11.claim: The verse implies that even people with true faith incur a kind of loss if they do not perform righteous deeds and counsel truth and patience.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r11.anchor: Hakk’a iman etmekle beraber sâlih ameller yapmayan ve hak ve sabır tavsiye etmeyen kimseler de bir nevi hüsrandan hâriç kalmamış olurlar

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r12.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r12.speaker: Mürcienin
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r12.claim: The Murji'a claim that lack of action causes no loss once faith exists is false; Ahl al-Sunna correctly holds that sinful, disobedient believers also incur a kind of loss.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r12.anchor: “iman olunca amelsizlik ziyan etmez” diyen Mürcienin kavilleri hak değildir. Doğrusu ehl-i sünnetin dedikleri gibi imanı olup da imanına göre âmil olmayan fâsıklar, âsîler için de bir nevi hüsran

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r14.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r14.speaker: Ebû Medîne
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r14.claim: He reports that two of the Prophet's Companions would not part after meeting until they recited Sūrat al-ʿAṣr to each other and then exchanged greetings.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r14.anchor: Ebû Medîne’den[^57]-ki sohbeti vardır- şöyle dediğini rivayet eylemişlerdir

ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r15.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r15.speaker: author
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r15.claim: The author urges his contemporaries to notice time passing, counsel truth and patience, and seek success in good works through complete faith; those who mock such counsel face the severe loss described next.
ELMALILI:103:1-3#6/r15.anchor: birbirlerimize hak ve sabır tavsiye etmeye ve Hak teâlâ’ya îmân-ı kâmil ile güzel amellere muvaffakiyet dilemeye ihtiyâcımız ne kadar çok

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r8.claim: Sincere faith is the first trait that saves people from loss; the commentary refers readers to other passages on faith.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r8.anchor: Samimi bir şekilde iman etmek (iman hakkında bk. Kur’an Yolu, Bakara 2/256; Nisâ 4/136-137)

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r9.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r9.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r9.claim: Beneficial deeds for this world and the hereafter mean doing what religion, reason, and conscience command and avoiding what they forbid.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r9.anchor: Dünya ve âhiret için yararlı işler yapmak, yani din, akıl ve vicdanın emrettiklerini yerine getirmek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r10.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r10.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r10.claim: Counseling one another to uphold truth is a further quality that saves from loss.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r11.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r11.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r11.claim: Counseling one another to be patient is a further quality that saves from loss.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r12.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r12.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r12.claim: Good works already include urging truth and patience, but these are named separately because they show virtue and responsibility toward others and produce social benefit.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r12.anchor: hem bireyin erdemini ve hemcinslerine karşı sorumluluk bilincini yansıttığı hem de bireyi aşarak toplumsal yararlar doğurduğu için önemi dolayısıyla ayrıca zikredilmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r13.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r13.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r13.claim: The command to counsel truth and patience also implies that a person must first follow these duties; this is too obvious to require explicit statement.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r13.anchor: bu görevlere kişinin öncelikle kendisinin uyması gerektiği anlamının da bulunduğu kuşkusuzdur

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r14.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r14.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r14.claim: Counseling truth and patience illuminates education's importance, nature, and purpose: education transmits truth in belief, knowledge, and ethics and builds resilience against hardship, error, and wrongdoing.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r14.anchor: Doğru bir eğitim faaliyetinin amacı ise insanlara inançta, bilgide ve ahlâkta hakkı yani gerçeği ve doğruyu aktarmak

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r15.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r15.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r15.claim: Truth and patience encompass the moral duties of social life; truth opposes falsehood and is linked to justice and a social order that protects everyone's rights.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r15.anchor: hak, adaletle de yakından ilişkilidir. Bu açıdan âyette insanların âdil olmaları ve adalet düzeninin

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r16.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r16.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r16.claim: Through faith and good works a servant fulfills God's rights, and through mutual counsel in truth and patience fulfills the rights of other people.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r16.anchor: iman ve sâlih amel sayesinde Allah’ın hakkını, hakkı ve sabrı tavsiye ile de kulların hakkını ödemiş olur

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r17.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r17.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r17.claim: Despite its brevity, Surah al-Asr contains a rich summary of the Qur'an's religious and moral duties and counsels.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r17.anchor: Kur’an-ı Kerîm’deki bütün dinî ve ahlâkî yükümlülüklerin, öğütlerin özü sayılmaya değer

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r18.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r18.speaker: İmam Şâfiî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r18.claim: Al-Shafi'i is quoted as saying that this short surah alone would suffice humanity if nothing else had been revealed, since it embraces all Qur'anic sciences.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r18.anchor: Şayet Kur’an’da başka bir şey nâzil olmasaydı, şu pek kısa sûre bile insanlara yeterdi. Bu sûre Kur’an’ın bütün ilimlerini kucaklıyor

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r19.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r19.speaker: Mehmet Âkif Ersoy
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r19.claim: Akif's poem presents true faith, righteous conduct, truth, and steadfastness as the sequence that saves humanity from loss.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:103:1/r19.anchor: Başta îmân-ı hakîkî geliyor sonra salâh Sonra hak sonra sebât: İşte kuzum insanlık Dördü birleşti mi yoktur sana hüsrân artık

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r2.claim: Those exempted have certain knowledge that only God truly acts, break through the veil of time, acquire enduring virtues, and profit by exchanging transient goods for lasting ones; this perfects the self.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r2.anchor: بالله الإيمان العلمي اليقيني وعرفوا أن لا مؤثر بالحقيقة إلا الله

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r3.claim: Some groups infer from the exception that grave sinners remain forever in loss; the author replies that the unexcepted may be eternally punished if unbelieving, enter the Fire if unpardoned sinners, or lose high degrees if forgiven.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r3.anchor: واستدل بعض الطوائف بالآية على أن مرتكب الكبيرة مخلد لأنه لم يستثن من الخسران إلا الذين آمنوا

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r4.claim: Mutual exhortation to truth perfects others: it means affirming enduring, undeniable truth, including faith in God and following His books and messengers in belief and action.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r4.anchor: بيان لتكميلهم لغيرهم أي وصى بعضهم بعضا بالأمر الثابت

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r5.claim: Exhorting one another to patience means resisting desired sins, performing difficult obedience, and receiving trials from God with inward and outward contentment; it is emphasized either for its importance or to distinguish worship from servitude.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r5.anchor: أي عن المعاصي التي تشتاق إليها النفس بحكم الجبلة البشرية

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r6.claim: God names the path to profit rather than enumerating loss, both to focus on eternal success and to leave other losses unstated as an act of generosity.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r6.anchor: ولعله سبحانه إنما ذكر سبب الربح دون الخسران اكتفاء ببيان المقصود

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r7.speaker: رسول الله
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r7.claim: A report swears that Abu Jahl is in loss except for four qualities, represented respectively by Abu Bakr’s faith, Umar’s good works, Uthman’s truth, and Ali’s patience; Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Abbas gave this gloss from the pulpit.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r7.anchor: وروى عنه عليه السلام أنه قال أقسم ربكم بآخر النهار أن أبا جهل لفي خسر إلا الذين آمنوا

BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r8.speaker: الشافعي
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r8.claim: Al-Shafi‘i says that if this surah alone had been revealed to people, it would have sufficed them; another report says it encompasses all Quranic learning.
BURSEVI:v10p390#3/r8.anchor: أنها سورة لو لم ينزل إلى الناس إلا هي لكفتهم

QASHANI:103:3/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:103:3/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:103:3/r4.claim: The exception knows God as sole agent, passes beyond time's veil, and acquires lasting virtues and perfected light beyond original potential.
QASHANI:103:3/r4.anchor: بالله الإيمان العلمي اليقيني وعرفوا أن لا مؤثر إلا الله وبرزوا عن حجاب الدهر

QASHANI:103:3/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:103:3/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:103:3/r5.claim: Counseling truth means affirming enduring unity and justice, including unity of essence, attributes, and acts; patience is steadfastness in servanthood, harder than reaching truth.
QASHANI:103:3/r5.anchor: أي: الثابت الدائم الباقي على حاله أبدا من التوحيد والعدل، أي: التوحيد الذاتي والوصفي والفعلي

QASHANI:103:3/r6.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:103:3/r6.speaker: author
QASHANI:103:3/r6.claim: Alternatively, time means pressing: God refines people by trial, struggle, and discipline until their essence is purified; only those counseling truth and patience escape loss.
QASHANI:103:3/r6.anchor: ويجوز أن يؤخذ العصر بمعنى المصدر من عصر يعصر أي: وعصر الله الإنسان بالبلاء والمجاهدة والرياضة

SULAMI:v2p419#3/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p419#3/r1.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p419#3/r1.claim: Counseling one another with truth means abiding with the Real and following His commands with steadiness.
SULAMI:v2p419#3/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم : التواصي بالحق هو المقام مع الحق والقيام بأوامره على حدود الاستقامة

SULAMI:v2p419#3/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p419#3/r2.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p419#3/r2.claim: Counseling patience means not making one's affliction an occasion for complaint; the poem depicts hiding longing lest tears betray it.
SULAMI:v2p419#3/r2.anchor: وقال بعضهم : التواصي بالصبر هو أن لا تشهد البلاء بحال وانشد

TUSTARI:103:3/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r1.claim: Belief and righteous deeds mean performing the obligatory duties as prescribed.
TUSTARI:103:3/r1.anchor: يعني أدوا الفرائض كما فرضت عليهم

TUSTARI:103:3/r2.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r2.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r2.claim: Counseling one another with truth means counseling one another by God.
TUSTARI:103:3/r2.anchor: { وتواصوا بالحق } [3] أي بالله عز وجل.

TUSTARI:103:3/r3.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r3.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r3.claim: Counseling one another with patience means patience in God's command.

TUSTARI:103:3/r4.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r4.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r4.claim: No deed or reward exceeds patience; piety is the only provision and requires patience, for which only God can help.
TUSTARI:103:3/r4.anchor: قيل: وما الصبر؟ قال: لا عمل أفضل من الصبر، ولا ثواب أكبر من ثواب الصبر ولا زاد إلا التقوى

TUSTARI:103:3/r5.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r5.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r5.claim: Patience is part of action as the head is part of the body; neither is sound without the other.
TUSTARI:103:3/r5.anchor: قيل: الصبر من الأعمال؟ قال: نعم الصبر من العمل بمنزلة الرأس من الجسد، لا يصلح أحدهما إلا بصاحبه.

TUSTARI:103:3/r6.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r6.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r6.claim: The greatest patience is waiting for relief from the Real.
TUSTARI:103:3/r6.anchor: قيل: ما أجل الصبر؟ قال: أجله انتظار الفرج من الحق.

TUSTARI:103:3/r7.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r7.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r7.claim: Patience begins by struggling against the self to perform worship correctly and endure avoiding every sin, small or great.
TUSTARI:103:3/r7.anchor: قيل: فما أصل الصبر؟ قال: مجاهدة النفس على إقامة الطاعات وأدائها بأحكامها وحدودها

TUSTARI:103:3/r8.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r8.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r8.claim: People who endure hardship only to obtain worldly desires practice blameworthy patience; those who seek the hereafter's reward and fear its punishment practice praiseworthy patience.
TUSTARI:103:3/r8.anchor: قيل: والناس في الصبر كيف هم؟ قال: الناس في الصبر صنفان

TUSTARI:103:3/r9.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r9.speaker: author
TUSTARI:103:3/r9.claim: Three obligatory stations are patience in obedience, avoidance of sin, and acceptance of God's acts or decree; patience with other people's acts is a virtue, and patience is better than retaliation.
TUSTARI:103:3/r9.anchor: قيل: فالصبر للآخرة هو على نوع واحد أو على أنواع؟ قال: الصبر للآخرة له أربع مقامات

TUSTARI:103:3/r10.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r10.speaker: أويس القرني
TUSTARI:103:3/r10.claim: Uways apologizes to God for every hungry or unclothed person, explaining that his only food is what is in his stomach and his only worldly possession is his garment.
TUSTARI:103:3/r10.anchor: ولقد لحق رجل بأويس القرني رحمه الله فسمعه يقول: اللهم إني أعتذر إليك اليوم من كل كبد جائعة

TUSTARI:103:3/r11.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:103:3/r11.speaker: أويس القرني
TUSTARI:103:3/r11.claim: Uways praises God in every state, says death and God's claims on wealth leave no room for worldly joy, and persists in enjoining right despite insults and slander.
TUSTARI:103:3/r11.anchor: يا أويس كيف أصبحت؟ أو قال: وكيف أمسيت؟ قال: أحمد الله على كل حال

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p538#8/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p538#8/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p538#8/r1.claim: Those who believe and do good works have their reward undiminished.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p538#8/r1.anchor: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات} فإنهم غير منقوصين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r1.claim: The exception completes the division into those who lose and those untouched by loss; believers who do good avoid loss if they leave no good undone by committing its opposite, or repent.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r1.anchor: فالذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لا يلحقهم الخسران بحال إذا لم يتركوا شيئا من الصالحات

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r2.claim: Repentance is among the greatest good works; genuine faith with no sin, or sin followed by repentance, yields the opposite of loss: a good final outcome.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r2.anchor: ومن أكبر الأعمال الصالحات التوبة من الذنوب لمقترفيها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r3.claim: Loss has degrees: eternal loss comes from denying God's oneness and the Messenger; lesser loss varies with evil deeds, and minor sins may be forgiven when major sins are avoided, as in 11:114.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r3.anchor: فأعظمه وخالده الخسر المنجر عن انتفاء الإيمان بوحدانية الله وصدق الرسول

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r6.claim: Al-ṣāliḥāt is generic yet comprehensive of every commanded good deed, including avoiding sins; the exception's relative clause states why they are spared loss.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p531/r6.anchor: والتعريف في قوله : { الصالحات } تعريف الجنس مراد به الاستغراق

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r1.claim: Counseling one another about truth includes all religious interests, including Islamic belief and religious ethics; mutual counsel about patience includes good deeds and avoiding sins.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r2.claim: Patience underlies the virtues because moral discipline and good deeds require restraining desires; ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ's verse illustrates the effort.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r2.anchor: فإن الارتياض بالأخلاق الحميدة لا يخلو من حمل المرء نفسه على مخالفة شهوات كثيرة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r3.claim: A prophetic report says Paradise is surrounded by hardships and Hell by desires; ʿAlī says patience is a mount that does not stumble.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r3.anchor: وفي الحديث : ( حفت الجنة بالمكاره وحفت النار بالشهوات )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r4.claim: The reciprocal form of “counsel one another” makes mutual exhortation to truth and patience a regular feature of believers' lives and presumes they practice what they commend.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r4.anchor: وأفادت صيغة التواصي بالحق وبالصبر أن يكون شأن حياة المؤمنين قائما على شيوع التآمر بهما

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r5.claim: This presumption recalls God's rebuke to the Children of Israel for enjoining virtue while neglecting it, and the criticism of failing to urge feeding the poor.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p533/r5.anchor: وقد قال الله تعالى توبيخا لبني إسرائيل : أتأمرون الناس بالبر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r1.claim: The believers affirm God and His Messenger, obey God, counsel one another to uphold monotheism, the Qurʾān, and following the Messenger, and urge one another to patience in obedience and observance of the law.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r1.anchor: أي صدقوا الله ورسوله وعملوا بالطاعة وتواصوا بالحق أي بالتوحيد والقرآن واتباع الرسول

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r2.speaker: إبراهيم
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r2.claim: Ibrāhīm says people generally decline and weaken as they age, but believers continue to receive the reward for deeds they did in youth and health.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p225#2/r2.anchor: وقال إبراهيم في تفسير هذه السورة إن الإنسان إذا عمر في الدنيا لفي نقص وضعف إلا المؤمنين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p480/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p480/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p480/r3.claim: Counseling one another in truth means obeying and avoiding forbidden acts; counseling patience means enduring calamity, decrees, and the harm of those they urge to good and forbid from evil.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p480/r3.anchor: وهو أداء الطاعات، وترك المحرمات، {وتواصوا بالصبر} على المصائب والأقدار

KASHSHAF:103:3/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:103:3/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:103:3/r1.claim: Everyone loses in trade except the righteous, who buy the afterlife with the world and gain happiness; all who trade in the opposite way lose and suffer.
KASHSHAF:103:3/r1.anchor: أن الناس في خسران من تجارتهم إلا الصالحين وحدهم

KASHSHAF:103:3/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:103:3/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:103:3/r2.claim: Al-ḥaqq is what is established and may not rightly be denied, encompassing all goodness: monotheism, obedience, following scripture and messengers, and preferring the afterlife over the world.
KASHSHAF:103:3/r2.anchor: بالأمر الثابت الذي لا يسوغ إنكاره

KASHSHAF:103:3/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:103:3/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF:103:3/r3.claim: Patience means refraining from sins, maintaining obedience, and enduring whatever God uses to test His servants.
KASHSHAF:103:3/r3.anchor: عن المعاصي وعلى الطاعات ، على ما يبلو الله به عباده

KASHSHAF:103:3/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF:103:3/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
KASHSHAF:103:3/r4.claim: A report says reciting Sūrat al-ʿAṣr brings God's forgiveness and places the reciter among those who urge one another to truth and patience.
KASHSHAF:103:3/r4.anchor: من قرأ سورة ( والعصر ) غفر الله له

MUJAHID:v2p780#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p780#2/r1.speaker: كعب
MUJAHID:v2p780#2/r1.claim: He says الحق is God and faith in Him, while patience means steadfastness in God's obligations and decree.
MUJAHID:v2p780#2/r1.anchor: عن كعب ﴿ وتواصوا بالحق ﴾ قال الحق هو الله عز وجل والإيمان به ﴿ وتواصوا بالصبر ﴾ قال الصبر على فرائض الله وحكمه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r1.claim: Those exempted from loss traded worldly life for the afterlife and so profited and prospered.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r1.anchor: فإنهم اشتروا الآخرة بالدنيا فربحوا وسعدوا

NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r2.claim: Truth means what is firmly established and cannot rightly be denied: all good, including God's oneness, obedience, and following His books and messengers.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r2.anchor: بالأمر الثابت الذى لا يسوغ انكاره وهو الخير كله من توحيد الله وطاعته واتباع كتبه ورسله

NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r3.claim: Patience means refraining from sins, persisting in obedience, and enduring what God tests His servants with.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r3.anchor: ﴿ وتواصوا بالصبر ﴾ عن المعاصى أو على الطاعات وعلى ما يبلو به الله عباده

NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r4.claim: Both tawaṣṣaw verbs are past-tense forms coordinated with the preceding past verb.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p355#8/r4.anchor: وتواصوا فى الموضعين فعل ماض معطوف على ماض قبله

QURTUBI-FULL:6:151#3/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:6:151#3/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:6:151#3/r5.claim: The generic definite al-nafs parallels generic human statements qualified by exceptions; the verse forbids killing any protected life, Muslim or treaty-holder, except for a legally valid cause.
QURTUBI-FULL:6:151#3/r5.anchor: وهذه الآية نهي عن قتل النفس المحرمة، مؤمنة كانت أو معاهدة إلا بالحق

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r1.claim: The exception is from humanity generally; doing righteous deeds means fulfilling obligations, and the author identifies the righteous as Companions.
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: { إلا الذين آمنوا } استثناء من الإنسان إذ هو بمعنى الناس

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r2.speaker: أبي بن كعب
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r2.claim: Ubayy ibn Kaʿb transmits a Prophetic interpretation mapping virtues to figures: Abu Bakr for faith, ʿUmar for deeds, ʿUthman for truth, and ʿAli for patience.
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r2.anchor: قال أبي بن كعب: قرأت على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم «والعصر» ثم قلت

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas is also reported to have given the same interpretation from the pulpit as his own statement.
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r3.anchor: وهكذا خطب ابن عباس على المنبر موقوفا عليه.

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r4.claim: Tawāṣaw means loving, advising, and urging one another.
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r4.anchor: ومعنى { وتواصوا } أي تحابوا أوصى بعضهم بعضا، وحث بعضهم بعضا.

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r5.speaker: الضحاك عن ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r5.claim: Dahhak transmits from Ibn ʿAbbas that the truth means monotheism.
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r5.anchor: { بالحق } أي بالتوحيد كذا روى الضحاك عن ابن عباس.

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r6.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r6.claim: Qatadah says the truth is the Qur'an; al-Suddi says it is God.

QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r7.claim: Counseling one another to patience means urging obedience to God and restraint from sins.
QURTUBI-FULL:103:3/r7.anchor: { وتواصوا بالصبر } على طاعة الله عز وجل، والصبر عن معاصيه.

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r1.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r1.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r1.claim: Quṭb discusses faith’s nature and value in life, not its juristic definition: it connects finite humanity to the eternal source, the cosmos, its laws, and its stored powers, widening human strength, lifespan, and horizon.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r1.anchor: نحن لا نعرف الإيمان هنا تعريفه الفقهي ؛ ولكننا نتحدث عن طبيعته وقيمته في الحياة . إنه اتصال هذا الكائن الإنساني الفاني الصغير المحدود بالأصل المطلق الأزلي الباقي

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r2.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r2.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r2.claim: This connection lets people enjoy existence, beauty, and fellow creatures, making life a joyful divine festival and a gain beyond comparison; losing faith is incomparable loss.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r2.anchor: فإنه يمنحه إلى جانب هذا كله متاعا بالوجود وما فيه من جمال ، ومن مخلوقات تتعاطف أرواحها مع روحه . فإذا الحياة رحلة في مهرجان إلهي

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r3.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r3.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r3.claim: Worship of one God frees people from servitude to others, establishes their equality, and yields genuine liberation because only one power and deity exists.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r3.anchor: التعبد لإله واحد ، يرفع الإنسان عن العبودية لسواه ، ويقيم في نفسه المساواة مع جميع العباد

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r4.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r4.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r4.claim: God-centeredness makes God the source of human values, laws, and judgments, replacing caprice and self-interest with revealed law and justice and giving believers confidence to withstand other value systems.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r4.anchor: والربانية التي تحدد الجهة التي يتلقى منها الإنسان تصوراته وقيمه وموازينه واعتباراته وشرائعه وقوانينه

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r5.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r5.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r5.claim: A clear, unmediated distinction between Creator and creature joins transient humanity to lasting truth, bringing inner light, calm, confidence, and relief from fear, anxiety, and unjust arrogance.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r5.anchor: ووضوح الصلة بين الخالق والمخلوق ، وتبين مقام الألوهية ومقام العبودية على حقيقتهما الناصعة

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r6.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r6.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r6.claim: Steadfast adherence to God’s way makes goodness purposeful, sustained, and cooperative across a Muslim community and successive generations rather than sporadic or temporary.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r6.anchor: والاستقامة على المنهج الذي يريده الله . فلا يكون الخير فلتة عارضة ، ولا نزوة طارئة ، ولا حادثة منقطعة

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r7.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r7.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r7.claim: Belief in human dignity before God raises self-respect and moral shame; Quṭb condemns Darwinian, Freudian, and Marxist insinuations that degradation is natural and therefore nothing to feel ashamed of.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r7.anchor: ومن هنا كانت إيحاءات الدارونية والفرويدية والماركسية هي أبشع ما تبتلى به الفطرة البشرية

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r8.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r8.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r8.claim: Human dignity and awareness that God sees consciences directly purify feelings; a believer senses God’s gaze and therefore cleans the inner self.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r8.anchor: ونظافة المشاعر تجيء نتيجة مباشرة للشعور بكرامة الإنسان على الله . ثم برقابة الله على الضمائر واطلاعه على السرائر

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r9.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r9.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r9.claim: Moral sensibility naturally follows belief in a just, merciful, forgiving, loving God who hates evil, loves good, and knows hidden thoughts.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r9.anchor: والحاسة الأخلاقية ثمرة طبيعية وحتمية للإيمان بإله عادل رحيم عفو كريم ودود حليم ، يكره الشر ويحب الخير

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r10.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r10.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r10.claim: Free will under God’s comprehensive watch entails individual and collective responsibility toward good and all humanity; believers therefore act alertly, weigh consequences, and recognize their worth and duty in existence.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r10.anchor: وهناك التبعة المترتبة على حرية الإرادة وشمول الرقابة ، وما تثيره في حس المؤمن من يقظة وحساسية

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r11.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r11.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r11.claim: Faith redirects competition from worldly attractions to God’s better, lasting reward (83:26), easing anxiety about immediate results; trust that God never forgets good sustains lifelong work and resistance to evil.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r11.anchor: والارتفاع عن التكالب على أعراض الحياة الدنيا - وهو بعض إيحاءات الإيمان - واختيار ما عند الله ، وهو خير وأبقى

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r12.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r12.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r12.claim: Faith is the root and axis of every good: detached deeds wither, while faith organizes action into a coherent, purposeful, cooperative way of life.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r12.anchor: إن الإيمان هو أصل الحياة الكبير ، الذي ينبثق منه كل فرع من فروع الخير ، وتتعلق به كل ثمرة من ثماره

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r13.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r13.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r13.claim: The Qur’an nullifies deeds disconnected from faith, likening disbelievers’ work to windblown ash (14:18) and a mirage (24:39), since faith supplies an enduring motive and a goal aligned with existence’s purpose.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r13.anchor: مثل الذين كفروا بربهم أعمالهم كرماد اشتدت به الريح في يوم عاصف . لا يقدرون مما كسبوا على شيء

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r14.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r14.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r14.claim: Faith reflects sound human nature and harmony with the cosmos; rejection indicates a defect in the human receiver and loss, and even apparently good deeds then lack validity.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r14.anchor: إن الإيمان دليل على صحة الفطرة وسلامة التكوين الإنساني ، وتناسقه مع فطرة الكون كله

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r15.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r15.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r15.claim: The believer’s expansive, beautiful, happy world makes the worlds of unbelievers appear narrow, low, distorted, miserable, and lost.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r15.anchor: وإن عالم المؤمن من السعة والشمول والامتداد والارتفاع والجمال والسعادة بحيث تبدو إلى جانبه عوالم غير المؤمنين صغيرة

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r16.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r16.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r16.claim: Righteous action is faith’s natural fruit: once faith settles in the heart it moves outward; inert faith is counterfeit or dead, like a flower that gives off no fragrance.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r16.anchor: ما أن تستقر في الضمير حتى تسعى بذاتها إلى تحقيق ذاتها في الخارج في صورة عمل صالح

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r17.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r17.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r17.claim: Islamic faith means movement, action, building, and cultivation directed toward God, not inward withdrawal or good intentions without outward action.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r17.anchor: إنه ليس انكماشا وسلبية وانزواء في مكنونات الضمير . وليس مجرد النوايا الطيبة التي لا تتمثل في حركة

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r18.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r18.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r18.claim: Because God’s method is continuous, purposeful movement within existence, faith guides humanity to realize that same clean, constructive movement.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r18.anchor: وهذا المنهج حركة دائمة متصلة في صميم الوجود . صادرة عن تدبير ، متجهة إلى غاية

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r19.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r19.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r19.claim: Mutual exhortation to truth and patience depicts a distinct, unified Muslim community that recognizes its duty to uphold truth, justice, and good and to lead humanity toward faith and righteous action.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r19.anchor: أما التواصي بالحق والتواصي بالصبر فتبرز من خلالها صورة الأمة المسلمة - أو الجماعة المسلمة - ذات الكيان الخاص

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r20.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r20.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r20.claim: Exhorting one another to truth is essential because desire, self-interest, social assumptions, tyrants, and injustice obstruct it; mutual encouragement multiplies effort and keeps a cooperative community guarding the truth.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r20.anchor: والتواصي بالحق ضرورة . فالنهوض بالحق عسير . والمعوقات عن الحق كثيرة : هوى النفس ، ومنطق المصلحة

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r21.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r21.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r21.claim: Mutual exhortation to patience is essential for faith, good works, and defending justice amid self-struggle, opposition, suffering, brazen evil, and a long, slow path; shared purpose and support increase endurance.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r21.anchor: والتواصي بالصبر كذلك ضرورة . فالقيام على الإيمان والعمل الصالح ، وحراسة الحق والعدل ، من أعسر ما يواجه الفرد والجماعة

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r22.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r22.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r22.claim: Quṭb laments humanity’s widespread worldly loss and especially Muslims’ abandonment of God’s method and the Islamic banner for ethnic flags, despite Islam’s having first given Arabs righteous leadership.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r22.anchor: هذا والمسلمون - أو أصحاب دعوى الإسلام بتعبير أدق - هم أبعد أهل الأرض عن هذا الخير

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r23.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r23.speaker: أبو الحسن الندوي
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r23.claim: Al-Nadwi says Muslim leaders governed through revealed scripture and divine law rather than their own legislation, which he considers prone to ignorance, error, and injustice; he cites 6:122 and 5:8.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r23.anchor: أبو الحسن الندوي في كتابه القيم

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r24.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r24.speaker: أبو الحسن الندوي
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r24.claim: Al-Nadwi says Muslim leaders received prolonged moral formation under Muhammad, avoided seeking office, and treated authority as a trust and divine test for which they would answer; he invokes a Prophetic warning and 28:83, 4:58, and 6:165.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r24.anchor: أبو الحسن الندوي في كتابه القيم

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r25.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r25.speaker: أبو الحسن الندوي
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r25.claim: Al-Nadwi says Muslim rule served humanity rather than an Arab nation or empire, aiming to free people from servitude to people and bring them to God; he cites Rabīʿ b. ʿĀmir’s address to Yazdegerd.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r25.anchor: أبو الحسن الندوي في كتابه القيم

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r26.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r26.speaker: أبو الحسن الندوي
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r26.claim: Al-Nadwi presents equality across peoples, with piety as the sole distinction (49:13); he recounts ʿUmar’s defense of an Egyptian struck by ʿAmr’s son and says Muslim rulers shared learning and government with all peoples.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r26.anchor: أبو الحسن الندوي في كتابه القيم

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r27.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r27.speaker: أبو الحسن الندوي
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r27.claim: Al-Nadwi argues that human flourishing and sound civilization require balanced development of body, spirit, heart, mind, feeling, and action within a moral and religious social environment.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r27.anchor: أبو الحسن الندوي في كتابه القيم

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r28.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r28.speaker: أبو الحسن الندوي
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r28.claim: Al-Nadwi presents the Rightly Guided Caliphate as history’s finest model: spiritual, ethical, religious, intellectual, and material strengths combined, with ethical government, prosperity, few crimes, and humane social relations.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r28.anchor: أبو الحسن الندوي في كتابه القيم

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r29.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r29.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r29.claim: Quṭb says the rightly guided period embodied the civilization and banner of faith, good works, and communal exhortation outlined by Sūrat al-ʿAṣr.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r29.anchor: هذه بعض ملامح تلك الحقبة السعيدة التي عاشتها البشرية في ظل الدستور الإسلامي

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r30.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r30.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r30.claim: Earthly profit and loss pale beside the lasting afterlife outcome: Paradise and divine approval, or their loss; humans reach their appointed perfection or fall beneath even a stone in worth and comfort, as 78:40 depicts.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r30.anchor: في عالم الحقيقة ، هناك الربح والخسر : ربح الجنة والرضوان

QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r31.author: Sayyid Quṭb
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r31.speaker: author
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r31.claim: The sura sets one path out of loss: faith, righteous deeds, and a united community mutually guarding truth with patience; Quṭb reports that two Companions recited it to each other before parting as a mutual pledge.
QUTB-ZILAL:103:3/r31.anchor: لم يتفرقا حتى يقرأ أحدهما على الآخر سورة  " العصر "

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r1.speaker: من قال إن العمل غير داخل في مسمى الإيمان
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r1.claim: Those who exclude deeds from the definition of faith argue that the conjunction of faith and righteous deeds would otherwise be redundant.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r1.anchor: احتج من قال : العمل غير داخل في مسمى الإيمان ، بأن الله تعالى عطف عمل الصالحات على الإيمان

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r2.claim: The proposed analogy with repeated Qur'anic phrases fails: those repetitions single out the noblest member of a class, whereas righteous deeds are not the noblest things called faith.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r2.anchor: لأنا نقول هناك : إنما حسن ، لأن إعادته تدل على كونه أشرف أنواع ذلك الكلي ، وعمل الصالحات ليس أشرف أنواع الأمور المسماة بالإيمان

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r3.speaker: الحليمي
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r3.claim: Al-Ḥalīmī accepts repetition: although faith does not include righteous deeds, righteous deeds include faith, so the deed clause subsumes the faith clause.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r3.anchor: قال الحليمي : هذا التكرير واقع لا محالة ، لأن الإيمان وإن لم يشتمل على عمل الصالحات ، لكن قوله : { وعملوا الصالحات } يشتمل على الإيمان

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r4.speaker: الأولون
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r4.claim: The first group replies that repetition for emphasis is possible, but its absence is the default, enough to support their inference.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r4.anchor: أجاب الأولون وقالوا : إنا لا نمنع ورود التكرير لأجل التأكيد ، لكن الأصل عدمه ، وهذا القدر يكفي في الاستدلال

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r5.speaker: القاطعون بوعيد الفساق
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r5.claim: Those affirming the threat against grave sinners infer that anyone lacking either faith or righteous deeds remains in loss in this world and the next; since few have both, the saved are fewer than the doomed.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#2/r5.anchor: احتج القاطعون بوعيد الفساق بهذه الآية ، قالوا : الآية دلت على أن الإنسان في الخسارة مطلقا ، ثم استثنى : { الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصالحات }

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r1.claim: The exception consoles believers over lost time and youth because righteous action has brought them something better.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r1.anchor: أحدها : أنه تسلية للمؤمن من فوت عمره وشبابه ، لأن العمل قد أوصله إلى خير من عمره وشبابه

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r2.claim: It teaches that whatever calls one to obey God is good, while whatever distracts one from God is corruption.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r2.anchor: وثانيها : أنه تنبيه على أن كل ما دعاك إلى طاعة الله فهو الصلاح ، وكل ما شغلك عن الله بغيره فهو الفساد

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r3.speaker: المعتزلة
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r3.claim: The Muʿtazilites infer from calling deeds righteous that their goodness is intrinsic, not merely due to God's command, as the Ashʿarites hold.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r3.anchor: قالت المعتزلة : تسمية الأعمال بالصالحات تنبيه على أن وجه حسنها ليس هو الأمر على ما يقوله الأشعرية

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r4.speaker: الأشعرية
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r4.claim: The Ashʿarites answer that God calls deeds righteous without specifying whether this is because of qualities in them or because of the command.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r4.anchor: وأجابت الأشعرية بأن الله تعالى وصفها بكونها صالحة ، ولم يبين أنها صالحة بسبب وجوه عائدة إليها أو بسبب الأمر

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r5.claim: Loss needs no stated cause because it comes from either committing sin or omitting obedience, whereas profit comes only through action, so its cause is specified.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r5.anchor: قلنا : إنه لم يذكر سبب الخسر لأن الخسر كما يحصل بالفعل ، وهو الإقدام على المعصية يحصل بالترك ، وهو عدم الإقدام على الطاعة ، أما الربح فلا يحصل إلا بالفعل

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r6.claim: Alternatively, loss is stated broadly while profit is detailed and clarified, a presentation befitting divine generosity.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r6.anchor: وفيه وجه آخر ، وهو أنه تعالى في جانب الخسر أبهم ولم يفصل ، وفي جانب الربح فصل وبين ، وهذا هو اللائق بالكرم

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r7.claim: Believers urge others to their way because their strong love of obedience makes them seek others' obedience too; exhortation to truth covers all religion, knowledge and practice.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r7.anchor: لا يقتصرون على ما يخصهم بل يوصون غيرهم بمثل طريقتهم ليكونوا أيضا سببا لطاعات الغير كما ينبغي أن يكون عليه أهل الدين وعلى هذا الوجه قال تعالى : { وأبكارا يأيها الذين ءامنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا } فالتواصي بالحق يدخل فيه سائر الدين من علم وعمل

RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r8.claim: Exhortation to patience includes enduring the burdens of required duties and avoiding prohibitions, since both doing what is disliked and restraining desire are difficult.
RAZI-FULL:v32p84#3/r8.anchor: والتواصي بالصبر يدخل فيه حمل النفس على مشقة التكليف في القيام بما يجب ، وفي اجتنابهم ما يحرم إذ الإقدام على المكروه ، والإحجام عن المراد كلاهما شاق شديد

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r1.claim: Salvation depends on all four qualities; duties extend beyond oneself to calling others to religion, sincere counsel, enjoining right, forbidding wrong, and wishing for them what one wishes for oneself.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r1.anchor: حكم بالخسار على جميع الناس إلا من كان آتيا بهذه الأشياء الأربعة ، وهي الإيمان والعمل الصالح والتواصي بالحق والتواصي بالصبر ، فدل ذلك على أن النجاة معلقة بمجموع هذه الأمور

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r2.claim: The repetition of mutual exhortation can assign its first occurrence to calling to God and enjoining right, and its second to steadfastness and forbidding wrong.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r2.anchor: ثم كرر التواصي ليضمن الأول الدعاء إلى الله ، والثاني الثبات عليه ، والأول الأمر بالمعروف والثاني النهي عن المنكر

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r3.speaker: عمر
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r3.claim: ʿUmar asks God to show mercy to the person who points out his faults.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r3.anchor: وقال عمر : رحم الله من أهدى إلى عيوبي

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r4.claim: Truth is burdensome and accompanied by trials, which is why it is paired with mutual exhortation.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r4.anchor: دلت الآية على أن الحق ثقيل ، وأن المحن تلازمة ، فلذلك قرن به التواصي

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r5.claim: The past-tense tawaṣaw praises what they did and conveys their desire to remain steadfast in it, rather than issuing a command.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r5.anchor: إنما قال : { وتواصوا } ولم يقل : ويتواصون لئلا يقع أمرا بل الغرض مدحهم بما صدر عنهم في الماضي ، وذلك يفيد رغبتهم في الثبات عليه في المستقبل

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r6.speaker: أبو عمرو
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r6.claim: Abū ʿAmr reads al-ṣabr with a slight ishām of the bāʾ, without fully articulating it.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r6.anchor: قرأ أبو عمرو : { بالصبر } بشم الباء شيئا من الحرف ، لا يشبع

RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r7.speaker: أبو علي
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r7.claim: Abū ʿAlī says the slight articulation is acceptable in pause, but in liaison only by treating liaison as pause, which is rare in recitation.
RAZI-FULL:v32p85/r7.anchor: قال أبو علي : وهذا مما يجوز في الوقف ، ولا يكون في الوصل إلا على إجراء الوصل مجرى الوقف

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r1.speaker: Q

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r2.speaker: Bg, Q, Ṭs

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r3.speaker: Bg, Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r3.claim: “Truth” can mean faith and professing Divine Unity.
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r3.anchor: faith and professing Divine Unity (Bg, Ṭs)

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r4.speaker: Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r4.claim: It may mean telling those one leaves at death, “die not except in submission,” as in 3:102.
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r4.anchor: at the moment of death one says to those one leaves behind, and die not except in submission (3:102; Ṭs)

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r5.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r5.claim: Believers are elsewhere commanded to be patient and vie in patience, as in 3:200.
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r5.anchor: Elsewhere believers are commanded, Be patient, vie in patience (3:200).

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r6.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r6.claim: Exhorting one another to patience can mean sustaining religious practice through hardship and opposition.
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r6.anchor: encouraging one another in maintaining religious practice in the face of difficulties and opposition (R)

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r7.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r7.speaker: Sh
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r7.claim: The paired exhortations parallel belief in God and righteous deeds, and extend to what must be known and done.
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r7.anchor: The exhortation to truth and patience can thus be seen as an exhortation paralleling that between belief in God and performing righteous deeds (Sh)

STUDYQURAN:103:3/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r8.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r8.claim: Righteous deeds arise from and remain joined to faith in God; the sūrah emphasizes truth and patience amid widespread spiritual darkness and personal crises.
STUDYQURAN:103:3/r8.anchor: righteous deeds are believed to arise from and are always conjoined with faith and belief in God

TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r1.claim: To enjoin one another by the truth means urging one another to follow what God revealed in His Book, doing its commands and avoiding its prohibitions.
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة، {وتواصوا بالحق} [العصر: 3] " والحق: كتاب الله "

TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r2.claim: Qatāda identifies the truth as the Book of God.
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، {وتواصوا بالحق} [العصر: 3] " والحق: كتاب الله "

TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r3.speaker: الحسن
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r3.claim: Al-Ḥasan also identifies the truth as the Book of God.
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r3.anchor: عن الحسن، " {وتواصوا بالحق} [العصر: 3] قال: الحق كتاب الله "

TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r4.claim: To enjoin one another by patience means urging one another to remain patient in obedience to God.
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r4.anchor: وقوله: {وتواصوا بالصبر} [البلد: 17] يقول: وأوصى بعضهم بعضا بالصبر على العمل بطاعة الله.

TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r5.claim: Qatāda glosses patience as obedience to God.
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r5.anchor: عن قتادة، {وتواصوا بالصبر} [البلد: 17] قال: الصبر: طاعة الله "

TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r6.speaker: الحسن
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r6.claim: Al-Ḥasan also glosses patience as obedience to God.
TAB-FULL:v24p614#2/r6.anchor: عن الحسن: {وتواصوا بالصبر} [البلد: 17] قال: " الصبر: طاعة الله "

TABATABAI:103:3/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:3/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:103:3/r1.claim: Patience is unrestricted: it includes patience in obedience, abstention from sin, and endurance of calamities decreed by God.
TABATABAI:103:3/r1.anchor: وقد أطلق الصبر فالمراد به أعم من الصبر على طاعة الله، والصبر عن معصيته، والصبر عند النوائب التي تصيبه بقضاء

TABATABAI:103:3/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:3/r2.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABATABAI:103:3/r2.claim: Al-Qummi reports al-Sadiq saying that the exception of believers selects God's chosen people; the report applies faith to belief in Ali's wilayah and mutual counsel to instructing their descendants and successors in it.
TABATABAI:103:3/r2.anchor: في تفسير القمي بإسناده عن عبد الرحمن بن كثير عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام في قوله تعالى

TABATABAI:103:3/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:103:3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
TABATABAI:103:3/r3.claim: A report interprets the human in loss as Abu Jahl ibn Hisham and identifies Ali and Salman among those who believe and do good.
TABATABAI:103:3/r3.anchor: أخرج ابن مردويه عن ابن عباس في قوله

TABRISI:103:3/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:103:3/r2.claim: “Humanity” is collective rather than singular, as shown by the exception of believers; a reading from some transmitters of Abū ʿAmr uses a dialectal form.
TABRISI:103:3/r2.anchor: أراد بالإنسان الجمع دون المفرد بدلالة أنه استثنى منه الذين آمنوا

TABRISI:103:3/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r11.speaker: author
TABRISI:103:3/r11.claim: The exception comprises believers in God's unity who act in obedience.
TABRISI:103:3/r11.anchor: استثنى من جملة الناس المؤمنين المصدقين بتوحيد الله

TABRISI:103:3/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:103:3/r12.claim: Mutual exhortation to truth means urging one another to follow truth and leave falsehood; other views identify truth as Qurʾan, faith and unity, or a dying person's counsel to successors to die Muslim.
TABRISI:103:3/r12.anchor: أي وصى بعضهم بعضا باتباع الحق واجتناب الباطل

TABRISI:103:3/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r13.speaker: الحسن، قتادة
TABRISI:103:3/r13.claim: Al-Hasan and Qatāda identify the truth as the Qurʾan.

TABRISI:103:3/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r14.speaker: مقاتل
TABRISI:103:3/r14.claim: Maqātil identifies the truth as faith and God's oneness.

TABRISI:103:3/r15.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r15.speaker: author
TABRISI:103:3/r15.claim: Another interpretation is that believers tell those they leave behind at death to die only as Muslims.
TABRISI:103:3/r15.anchor: أن يقولوا عند الموت لمخلفيهم لا تموتن إلا وأنتم مسلمون

TABRISI:103:3/r16.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r16.speaker: الحسن، قتادة
TABRISI:103:3/r16.claim: Al-Hasan and Qatāda say patience means bearing hardship in obedience; another interpretation is refraining from disobedience.
TABRISI:103:3/r16.anchor: بالصبر على تحمل المشاق في طاعة الله عن الحسن وقتادة

TABRISI:103:3/r17.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r17.speaker: author
TABRISI:103:3/r17.claim: These believers escape loss and profit by earning reward through obedience and spending their lives in it, preserving their capital like a trader who makes profit.
TABRISI:103:3/r17.anchor: فإن هؤلاء ليسوا في خسر بل هم في أعظم ربح وزيادة

TABRISI:103:3/r19.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:103:3/r19.speaker: author
TABRISI:103:3/r19.claim: Mutual exhortation to truth and patience implies commanding right, forbidding wrong, calling to unity and justice, fulfilling duties, and avoiding reprehensible acts.
TABRISI:103:3/r19.anchor: إشارة إلى الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر والدعاء إلى التوحيد والعدل

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r1.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r1.claim: ʿAṭāʾ from Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the human being in the exception as al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, al-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil, and al-Aswad ibn ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r1.anchor: عطاء عن ابن عباس: يريد جماعة من المشركين: الوليد بن المغيرة، والعاص بن وائل، والأسود بن عبد المطلب

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r2.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r2.claim: Muqātil says the verse was revealed about Abū Lahab.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r3.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet identifies the human as Abū Jahl; the author treats these figures as included in the general term because believers are excepted from it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r3.anchor:
وروي مرفوعا أنه أبو جهل (¬1).
وهذا يحمل على أن هؤلاء ممن عني بلفظ الإنسان

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r4.claim: The exception means those who affirm God and His Messenger and act in obedience to Him.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r4.anchor: إلا الذين صدقوا الله ورسوله وعملوا بطاعته

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r5.speaker: الكلبي والحسن
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r5.claim: Al-Kalbī and al-Ḥasan say believers counsel one another to follow the Qurʾān as truth.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r6.speaker: مقاتل وأبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r6.claim: Muqātil takes the truth as God’s oneness; Abū Isḥāq chooses remaining firm in monotheism and faith in the Prophet.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r6.anchor: بتوحيد الله (¬5). وهو اختيار أبي إسحاق، قال: تواصوا بالإقامة على توحيد الله، والإيمان بنبيه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says they counsel patience in avoiding God’s disobedience and fulfilling His duties.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r7.anchor: ابن عباس: بالصبر عن (¬8) معاصي الله، وعلى فرائض الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r8.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r8.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet allegorically identifies the four qualities with Abū Bakr, ʿUmar, ʿUthmān, and ʿAlī respectively.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r8.anchor: وقال أبو حاتم: قرأ أبو عمرو بالصبر "بشمم الباء شيئا (من الجر) (¬3) ولا يشبع

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r9.speaker: أبو حاتم
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r9.claim: Abū Ḥātim says Abū ʿAmr recited al-ṣabr with a slight trace of the genitive on bāʾ without fully voicing it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r9.anchor: أبو حاتم: قرأ أبو عمرو بالصبر "بشمم الباء شيئا (من الجر) (¬3) ولا يشبع

WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r10.speaker: أبو علي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r10.claim: Abū ʿAlī says this slight inflection is not valid in a pause and only occurs in connected speech by treating liaison as a pause, citing poetry and reports of readings.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v24p297#2/r10.anchor: أبو علي: (وهما مما لا يجوز في الوقف، ولا يكون في الوصل إلا على إجراء الوصل مجرى الوقف

WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r1.claim: Those who believe are not among the losers; they counsel one another to remain in monotheism and faith and to be patient in obedience and striving in God’s path.
WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r1.anchor: فإنهم ليسوا في خسر { وتواصوا بالحق } وصى بعضهم بالإقامة على التوحيد والإيمان { وتواصوا بالصبر } على طاعة الله والجهاد في سبيله

WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r2.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet interprets the human as Abū Jahl, the believers as Abū Bakr, good deeds as ʿUmar, truth as ʿUthmān, and patience as ʿAlī.
WAHIDI-QT:103:3/r2.anchor: ويروى مرفوعا { إن الإنسان لفي خسر } يعني أبا جهل { إلا الذين آمنوا } يعني أبا بكر

ASAD-NOTES:103:1#n2/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:103:1#n2/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:103:1#n2/r1.claim: Asad gives the literal sense as humanity being in a state of loss, except for those who meet the stated conditions.
ASAD-NOTES:103:1#n2/r1.anchor: man is indeed in [a state of] loss, except those. . .
